title: Identity across screens and campaign formats

location.series: KMS TEAM / Audi and Audi Sport identity case study

slide_intent: Show related outputs together because consistency must survive both different devices and changing content.
strategic_value: Repeated rings and typographic character can connect Audi interfaces, print-like advertisements and film.
demonstration: A 15-second animated device-and-artwork montage changes content within a large screen, tablet, phone, watch and overlapping campaign panels on white.
practical_value: Compare which ingredients persist when screen shape and campaign imagery change.

content_islands.name: Device group
content_islands.spec: Arrange a large display behind a tablet, phone and watch.

content_islands.name: Campaign panels
content_islands.spec: Overlap photographic advertisements with red or white headlines in front and behind the devices.

content_islands.name: Changing media
content_islands.spec: Animate selected screen and panel content within the stable overall arrangement.

reference_purposes.Expression: The montage repeats rings and Audi typography across varied images.
reference_purposes.Application: Desktop, tablet, phone and watch examples show the same identity in different formats.
